summary: Vint Cerf's notes on how the IMP operating system controlled traffic flow in 1972, based on a BBN meeting. The goals included fewer needless retransmissions under heavy load and keeping reassembly from locking up. It is an informal account, and RFC 449 offers corrections and better references.

eli5.summary: A traffic cop for network messages that keeps roads from jamming. This note is one person's description of how the cop decided who may go.
